scene.title: SCENE III. France. The King's Palace

content.text: Flourish. Enter Lewis, the French King, his sister the Lady Bona, his Admiral called Bourbon, Prince Edward, Queen Margaret, and the Earl of Oxford. Lewis sits, and riseth up again.

lines.plainText: And birth that thou shouldst stand while Lewis doth sit

lines.plainText: And here to pledge my vow I give my hand

lines.text: Why stay we now? These soldiers shall be levied,
lines.plainText: Why stay we now These soldiers shall be levied

lines.text: And thou, Lord Bourbon, our High Admiral,
lines.plainText: And thou Lord Bourbon our High Admiral

lines.text: Shall waft them over with our royal fleet.
lines.plainText: Shall waft them over with our royal fleet

lines.text: I long till Edward fall by war's mischance
lines.plainText: I long till Edward fall by war's mischance

lines.text: For mocking marriage with a dame of France.
lines.plainText: For mocking marriage with a dame of France

lines.text: I came from Edward as ambassador,
lines.plainText: I came from Edward as ambassador

lines.text: But I return his sworn and mortal foe.
lines.plainText: But I return his sworn and mortal foe

lines.text: Matter of marriage was the charge he gave me,
lines.plainText: Matter of marriage was the charge he gave me

lines.text: But dreadful war shall answer his demand.
lines.plainText: But dreadful war shall answer his demand

lines.text: Had he none else to make a stale but me?
lines.plainText: Had he none else to make a stale but me

lines.text: Then none but I shall turn his jest to sorrow.
lines.plainText: Then none but I shall turn his jest to sorrow

lines.text: I was the chief that raised him to the crown,
lines.plainText: I was the chief that raised him to the crown

lines.text: And I'll be chief to bring him down again:
lines.plainText: And I'll be chief to bring him down again

lines.text: Not that I pity Henry's misery,
lines.plainText: Not that I pity Henry's misery

lines.text: But seek revenge on Edward's mockery.
lines.plainText: But seek revenge on Edward's mockery
